name: Octant-based Distributed Volume Rendering
definition: A distributed volume rendering technique that divides the volume into octants, assigns each octant to an independent worker process (server), and composites the resulting images at a central client process to produce a final image.
summary: Octant-based Distributed Volume Rendering partitions a 3D volume into eight fixed octants for parallel ray casting, distinguishing itself by using non-recursive subdivision and specific opacity corrections during compositing.
